research_question: Does a phase- and gain-invariant spectral-shape comparison to a prior self replay preserve fresh natural-speech world overlap while suppressing a repeated commanded self utterance?
retry_policy: This is the final candidate in the natural-speech workspace retry ladder. A fresh-run failure retires the ladder; no further representation or threshold retry may use the v3 held-out captures.

spent_v2_design_data.threshold_rule: maximum spent self-probe distance plus 10 percent of the clean gap to minimum spent overlap distance

representation.name: prior_self_replay_12_band_spectral_shape_distance
representation.per_capture_transform: Mean-center PCM, apply a Hann window, compute full-window power spectrum, sum power per band, add 1e-12, take natural log, subtract the 12-band mean, and L2-normalize the vector.
representation.world_evidence: Euclidean distance between the stored self-calibration vector and the current matching-efference vector.
representation.template_memory_bound: three workspace slots retaining one 12-scalar vector each; no cross-session growth

source_preparation.excerpt_rule: The unchanged v2 600 ms greatest-non-overlapping-RMS rule.

levels.only_change_from_v2: Reduce world playback by 3 dB because one v2 overlap clipped 18 samples; self level, normalization, chirps, and physical controls remain unchanged.

live_boundary.physical_geometry: Unchanged XVF3800 :0; Mac mini self at 4 cm/100 percent; External Headphones device 2 at 180 degrees/50 cm/approximately 50 percent knob; semi-quiet room with laptop fan

claim_boundary: A pass would support exact-efference source binding after one prior replay for three fresh natural-speech pairs at one fixed geometry. Spectral-shape distance is a compact sensory identity trace, not speech recognition, semantics, generalized self-voice learning, or biological fidelity.
